Product description

Our collection of Baby Boys and Girls Cotton Pajamas, are made from high-quality, breathable cotton, These are bio-washed for extra softness, sport rich and vibrant colours and embelished with cute and funky Animal design DTF Prints. Suitable for dailywear and as sleepwear. In summers, it keeps the baby cool. In winters these can be clubbed with thermal innerwear.
